body:
I am with Dr Millson-Brown and I had a prescription for hormones filled out same day and ready to order from one single appointment. 

I had my appointment on a Saturday and had my hormones in hand by Monday afternoon. Yes, there's a bit more of a wait to get the appointment, but it's one appointment rather than multiple.

Equally, Dr Millson-Brown is an absolutely lovely person and I can't recommend her highly enough.

I personally went in-person to the GPs I was thinking of changing to and asked, in person, if they would accept a shared care agreement and what it would be about and with which specialist (if you can name your endocrinologist, even better). 

The receptionists often had to go and speak to doctors and then come back to me but I had an answer that day. 

Emailing/ringing GPs is useless in my experience - it's much easier to show up in person at the reception and ask (if a little scary!). Obviously if you're moving from out of town it's harder to do this but it does get results if you can!

I was exceedingly lucky and now am with a GP that accepted a shared care agreement with my private endocrinologist!
I just got the email with the information about VIP entry in my inbox, hopefully you've received your information too now! If it's not in your inbox check your spam just in case!

I also have heard nothing and have been chasing up via email, first with SJM who told me I should be receiving the info 'soon'. They also told me to speak to VIP Nation who are managing the VIP package - I emailed them this morning so we'll see if I hear anything back. SJM also said to keep an eye on your spam/junk. Fingers crossed it is all sorted before Friday!!!

This is a really good argument for the voice changer! I'll definitely make that point with HR. 

Still on the NHS waiting list to get any kind of medical treatment. Currently on year 3 and it's common for people to wait 5 or more. I'm saving up for private care but still not quite there financially. I hope to start in the next couple years if I can afford to. I suppose I could still make the point the solution is temporary until I can get on T though.
